explanation: algo03_inventory.run() calls inventory_all_large_tracks.one() before publication_support(). For baseline jobs, one() obtains baseline_pair() replay proposed_associated_ids, including postfit-only IDs; it subtracts that replay mask before creating residual rows, omitting a native source if both current and earlier residual support have fewer than two points. publication_support() subsequently restricts owners to actual published ALGO02 gates and records replay-only IDs as unreported_postfit_ids, but does not rebuild inventory.json. The proposed/postfit-only distinction is explicit in the replay schema; inventory.summary.associated is therefore a replay/proposed count, not the published terminal count. Treating its residual inventory as the residual of published ownership suppresses unpublished support. This audit establishes an accounting/discovery-mask discrepancy, not that any replay-only ID meets acceptance gates or should be associated.
